macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks rebound in holiday-shortened session
items.summary: U.S. equities rose sharply on Friday, with the Dow gaining about 1.0%, the S&P 500 1.2% and the Nasdaq Composite 1.7%. The rally was led by a recovery in AI and semiconductor stocks after weeks of heavy selling.[6]

items.title: AI trade drives broad weekly market rebound
items.summary: The S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow ended a volatile week higher as investors returned to AI-related shares; one market report put weekly gains above 5% across the major U.S. indexes.[2]

items.title: Trade deficit widens to 19-month high
items.summary: The U.S. October trade deficit reportedly reached $149.5 billion, wider than the expected $136.0 billion and potentially negative for fourth-quarter GDP growth.[1]

items.title: Markets price further Federal Reserve tightening
items.summary: Market pricing reportedly implies a 100% probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike at the Fed’s December 8–9 meeting, while elevated inflation continues to pressure rate-sensitive assets.[1]

items.title: ECB official signals additional tightening may be needed
items.summary: ECB Governing Council member Primož Dolenc said this year’s rate increases may not be sufficient to return inflation to the 2% target and that further measures could be necessary in coming months.[1]

items.title: Nvidia and AI supply-chain developments remain market focus
items.summary: Nvidia reportedly paused some Southeast Asian server shipments amid new U.S. export controls, while renewed investor attention on AI stocks helped lift chipmakers during Friday’s rebound.[2]

items.title: Vertex shares fall after regulatory delay
items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals reportedly declined after U.S. regulators delayed a decision on its chronic-kidney-disease treatment by up to three months, adding uncertainty to the drug’s approval timeline.[7]

items.title: Altria considers bid for Imperial Brands
items.summary: Altria is reportedly considering an offer for cigarette maker Imperial Brands, potentially in partnership with Japan Tobacco.[7]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum decline over 24 hours
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $59,923, down 1.1% over 24 hours, while Ethereum was around $1,662.48, down 1.6%.

items.title: WLFI plunges as much as 50%
items.summary: The Trump-linked World Liberty Financial token WLFI fell sharply, with reports attributing the move to heavy selling and ether transfers from a wallet associated with the project. World Liberty Financial denied controlling Binance’s automated liquidation of WLFI perpetual positions.

items.title: EU crypto authorization register set for revamp
items.summary: The EU securities watchdog plans to make it easier for users to verify which crypto companies are authorized to operate in the bloc, as part of a broader MiCA-related transparency effort.

items.title: Binance plans tokenized IPO platform
items.summary: Binance CEO Yi He said the exchange plans to launch tokenized initial public offerings and support new listings, subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: Tether reports more than $7 billion in frozen USDT
items.summary: Tether said it has frozen more than $7 billion in USDT linked to illegal activity worldwide and has reissued $1.28 billion to law-enforcement agencies and victims.

items.title: Cryptio asks clients to revoke API keys after attack
items.summary: Crypto accounting firm Cryptio reportedly asked clients to revoke API keys following a security incident.

items.title: Bitcoin whales accumulate despite market weakness
items.summary: Bitcoin whales reportedly added about 121,000 BTC since the end of September, countering typical year-end selling patterns as prices weakened.

items.title: XRP Ledger native lending feature nears launch
items.summary: The XRP Ledger’s proposed native lending functionality is approaching launch, pending a final governance vote.

items.title: Solana validators urged to install urgent upgrade
items.summary: Solana core developer Anza issued an urgent recommendation for mainnet validators to upgrade to Agave v4.4.2 to support network security and stability.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: GTA VI captures record share of gaming attention
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI drew 31.4% of measured global gaming attention during its launch week, nearly three times Fortnite’s previous record, according to MCV/DEVELOP.

items.title: NAVI wins Brawl Stars World Finals 2026
items.summary: NAVI defeated FUT Esports 4–3 in Tokyo after advancing from the Last Chance Qualifier, taking the $450,000 first prize from the $1 million event.

items.title: PGL Major Singapore opens with major upsets
items.summary: The Counter-Strike 2 tournament’s opening stage featured several underdog victories, while s1mple’s return produced a difficult result against Liquid.

items.title: Warframe: Tau expansion announced for December 9
items.summary: Digital Extremes revealed a major free Warframe update featuring a new solar system, a two-hour story quest, detective missions and nighttime dog walking.

items.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong announces free Sea of Sorrow update
items.summary: Team Cherry announced that Sea of Sorrow, the game’s first major content update, will launch free for all players on December 11.

items.title: Yooka-Laylee Definitive Edition dated for December 15
items.summary: Playtonic announced an upgraded edition for PS5, Switch 2 and Steam, with visual improvements and a free upgrade for existing owners; the release is not planned for Xbox.

items.title: Marvelous plans cuts amid restructuring
items.summary: Marvelous reportedly offered early retirement as part of a plan to eliminate 65 console and PC positions.

items.title: Exoprimal to shut down permanently in 2027
items.summary: Capcom confirmed that Exoprimal will cease operation permanently in September 2027.

items.title: Azur Promilia launches in South Korea
items.summary: Manjuu’s open-world creature-collecting RPG launched on PC, iOS and Android after surpassing 30 million global pre-registrations; an English open beta is targeted for summer 2027.

items.title: EVO Japan 2027 lineup revealed
items.summary: EVO Japan will feature seven main games from April 29 to May 1, with Marvel Tokon making its debut in the tournament lineup.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.

items.title: Apple pauses online store ahead of Black Friday
items.summary: Apple temporarily took its online store offline by region ahead of Black Friday, with availability expected to resume after updates to its shopping experience and promotions.

items.title: Tesla reportedly seeks German machine-tool assets
items.summary: Tesla has filed to acquire assets of German machine-tool maker EMAG, a move that could strengthen its manufacturing and automation capabilities.

items.title: WhatsApp announces in-app travel eSIM purchases
items.summary: WhatsApp is reportedly adding travel eSIM purchases directly within the app, expanding its communications platform into travel connectivity services.

items.title: Samsung adds new health tools to Galaxy Watch8
items.summary: Samsung has introduced additional health features for the Galaxy Watch8 through its One UI 9 software update.

items.title: X adds post scheduling on Android
items.summary: X has rolled out post scheduling for Android users, allowing posts to be scheduled as far as 18 months in advance.
